item.title: USD/CHF consolidates around 0.7950 as investors await US inflation data
item.description: The USD/CHF pair trades in a tight range around 0.7950 during the late Asian trading session on Thursday. The Swiss Franc pair wobbles as investors await the United States (US) inflation data for November, which will be published at 13:30 GMT.

item.title: EUR/GBP gathers strength above 0.8750, all eyes on ECB and BoE rate decicions
item.description: The EUR/GBP cross gathers strength to near 0.8785 during the early European session on Thursday. The Pound Sterling (GBP) weakens against the Euro (EUR) on softer-than-expected UK inflation data and firming Bank of England (BoE) rate cut bets.

item.title: GBP/JPY holds steady above 208.00 as BoE and BoJ rate decisions loom
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross struggles to build on a goodish rebound from the 206.75 area, or a one-week low, touched on Tuesday, and oscillates in a narrow band during the Asian session on Thursday.

item.description: The United States (US) Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) will publish the all-important Consumer Price Index (CPI) data for November on Thursday at 13:30 GMT.

item.title: Japanese Yen languishes near weekly low against USD; focus remains on BoJ policy update
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) trades with a negative bias against the recovering US Dollar (USD) for the second straight day, pushing the USD/JPY pair closer to the 156.00 mark or the weekly top.

item.title: Gold declines on profit-taking ahead of US CPI inflation release
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) edges lower below $4,350 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. The precious metal retreats from seven-week highs amid some profit-taking and a rebound in the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: USD/INR falls on hopes of RBI’s follow-through intervention
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) moves higher against the US Dollar (USD) after a flat opening on Thursday. The USD/INR pair drops to near 90.50 amid expectations that the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) could intervene again to support the Indian Rupee.
